description: Project foundation: scaffold the Vite React-TS app with pnpm enforcement, configure Tailwind v3 (darkMode:'class' + brand amber + Inter), create the centralized src/config.ts, the i18n setup (es primary / en fallback), the Supabase client, and shared TypeScript types. Leaves a buildable stub app wired with i18n and Tailwind. Independent foundation that FEAT-002 (SQL) and FEAT-003 (UI/meta) build on.
steps: Create package.json: name 'rifa', "version": "0.1.0", "private": true, "type": "module", "packageManager": "pnpm@10.17.0", scripts { dev: 'vite', build: 'tsc -b && vite build', preview: 'vite preview' }. dependencies: react ^18, react-dom ^18, react-router-dom ^6, @supabase/supabase-js ^2, i18next ^23, react-i18next ^14, i18next-browser-languagedetector ^8. devDependencies: typescript ^5, vite ^5, @vitejs/plugin-react ^4, tailwindcss ^3.4, postcss ^8, autoprefixer ^10, @types/react ^18, @types/react-dom ^18.

Create tsconfig.json and tsconfig.node.json (standard Vite react-ts: target ES2020, module ESNext, moduleResolution bundler, jsx react-jsx, strict true, noUnusedLocals/Parameters true). tsconfig.json references tsconfig.node.json for vite.config.ts.
Create index.html with #root div and script module src=/src/main.tsx; lang='es'; title 'Rifa'.
Create src/vite-env.d.ts declaring ImportMetaEnv for VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, VITE_APP_VERSION (all string | undefined) plus the vite/client reference.

Create tailwind.config.js: darkMode:'class', content ['./index.html','./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'], theme.extend.colors.brand = amber scale (50..900, DEFAULT ~#F59E0B, 600 #D97706), fontFamily.sans ['Inter','system-ui','sans-serif']. Create postcss.config.js with tailwindcss + autoprefixer plugins.
Create src/index.css: import Inter (via @import or font stack note), then @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; set body font-sans and a base light/dark background.

Create src/config.ts: export ADMIN_EMAILS = ['leandroovalle02@gmail.com','jacoboovallegiraldo@gmail.com','juan.feliperodriguezgarcia1508@gmail.com'] — three real admin emails, ALL stored lowercased, no pending placeholder (Felipe aka Pipe's email is included). Comment that the allow-list must be compared case-insensitively. export WHATSAPP_NUMBERS = { jaco: '573125556018', pipe: '573115469638', test: '573143933641' } — all three real numbers present, each clearly commented (Jaco, Pipe, user's test number). export WHATSAPP_ACTIVE_DESTINATION = WHATSAPP_NUMBERS.test with a comment: 'TESTING PHASE: all purchase-intent notifications go to the test number 573143933641 only. To go live later, change this ONE line to WHATSAPP_NUMBERS.jaco (or .pipe).' Do NOT switch the active destination off the test number now. export RAFFLE = { ticketPriceCOP: 10000, drawDate: '2026-10-29', prize: 'Nintendo Switch + AirPods 4', numberMin: 1, numberMax: 999, lotteryName: 'Loteria de Bogota' } plus a format3(n:number):string helper returning zero-padded 3-digit string. Comment every value.

Also export a helper isAdminEmail(email: string | null | undefined): boolean in src/config.ts that lowercases its argument and checks membership in ADMIN_EMAILS (which are stored lowercased) — used by client gating for case-insensitive comparison.

Create src/types.ts: export type Status = 'available' | 'reserved' | 'paid'; export type SoldBy = 'Felipe' | 'Pipe'; export interface Ticket { number:number; status:Status; buyer_name:string|null; buyer_phone:string|null; buyer_email:string|null; sold_by:SoldBy|null; reserved_at:string|null; paid_at:string|null; is_winner:boolean; created_at:string; updated_at:string } ; export interface PublicTicket { number:number; status:Status; is_winner:boolean }. These literals MUST match supabase SQL (FEAT-002).

Create src/lib/supabase.ts: import { createClient }; read import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (throw a clear console warning if missing); export const supabase = createClient(url, anonKey, { auth: { detectSessionInUrl: true, persistSession: true, autoRefreshToken: true } }).

Create src/i18n/index.ts: i18next.use(LanguageDetector).use(initReactI18next).init({ resources: { es:{translation:es}, en:{translation:en} }, fallbackLng:'en', interpolation:{escapeValue:false}, detection:{ order:['navigator','htmlTag','localStorage'], caches:['localStorage'] } }). Spanish must be chosen for Colombian 'es-CO' via base-language fallback.

Create src/i18n/locales/es.json and en.json with ALL keys needed by the whole app (banner, raffle copy, public grid/legend, search, counters sold/paid/raised/projected, reserve form fields + validation + submit, whatsapp message template with placeholders {number}{name}{phone}, admin login button 'Iniciar sesion con Google', accessDenied, signOut, admin table headers, filters status/seller, perSellerTotal, markPaid, release, winner input + result, csvExport, footer). Spanish neutral, no regional slang. en.json is a complete mirror.
Create src/main.tsx: import './index.css', import './i18n', render <App/> inside React.StrictMode and BrowserRouter.
Create a minimal src/App.tsx stub (routes placeholder) so the app builds; FEAT-003 replaces it with real routes.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm install completes and pnpm-lock.yaml exists.
pnpm run build completes with zero TypeScript errors.

src/config.ts ADMIN_EMAILS contains all three real emails lowercased (leandroovalle02@gmail.com, jacoboovallegiraldo@gmail.com, juan.feliperodriguezgarcia1508@gmail.com) with no placeholder, plus an isAdminEmail() case-insensitive helper; WHATSAPP_NUMBERS has jaco/pipe/test all present and commented; WHATSAPP_ACTIVE_DESTINATION resolves to 573143933641 with the documented one-line-switch comment.
tailwind.config.js has darkMode:'class', a brand color, and Inter in fontFamily.sans.
i18n initializes with es resources and en fallback; no hardcoded user-facing strings introduced.
verification: cd into the quoted workspace root and run: pnpm install
pnpm run build  (expect: success, no TS errors)

Confirm pnpm-lock.yaml present; confirm ADMIN_EMAILS has the three real emails (lowercased), WHATSAPP_NUMBERS has jaco=573125556018, pipe=573115469638, test=573143933641, and WHATSAPP_ACTIVE_DESTINATION === WHATSAPP_NUMBERS.test in src/config.ts
findings:
FOUNDATION COMPLETE & BUILD-VERIFIED (pnpm install + pnpm run build both succeed, 0 TS errors, pnpm-lock.yaml committed).

ENVIRONMENT PINS (important for later FEATs):
- Node 20.19.2 is installed and .npmrc has engine-strict=true. The latest @supabase/supabase-js (>=2.110) requires Node >=22, which FAILS under engine-strict. Pinned to "@supabase/supabase-js": "~2.105.0" (resolved 2.105.4, engines.node >=20.0.0). DO NOT bump supabase-js past 2.105.x unless Node is upgraded to 22. Other installed versions: react 18.3.1, react-dom 18.3.1, react-router-dom 6.30.6, i18next 23.16.8, react-i18next 14.1.3, i18next-browser-languagedetector 8.2.1, vite 5.4.21, tailwindcss 3.4.19, typescript 5.9.3, @vitejs/plugin-react 4.7.0.

EXPORTS AVAILABLE TO FEAT-002/003:
- src/config.ts: ADMIN_EMAILS (readonly string[], 3 real emails lowercased), isAdminEmail(email): boolean (case-insensitive), WHATSAPP_NUMBERS = { jaco:'573125556018', pipe:'573115469638', test:'573143933641' } as const, WHATSAPP_ACTIVE_DESTINATION (=== WHATSAPP_NUMBERS.test = '573143933641' during testing; one-line switch comment present), RAFFLE = { ticketPriceCOP:10000, drawDate:'2026-10-29', prize:'Nintendo Switch + AirPods 4', numberMin:1, numberMax:999, lotteryName:'Loteria de Bogota' } as const, format3(n):string (zero-pads to 3 digits).
- src/types.ts: type Status = 'available'|'reserved'|'paid'; type SoldBy = 'Felipe'|'Pipe'; interface Ticket (number,status,buyer_name,buyer_phone,buyer_email,sold_by,reserved_at,paid_at,is_winner,created_at,updated_at); interface PublicTicket (number,status,is_winner). FEAT-002 SQL MUST match these literals and the public_tickets view must expose exactly {number,status,is_winner}.
- src/lib/supabase.ts: default-less named export `supabase` (createClient with auth {detectSessionInUrl, persistSession, autoRefreshToken}). Warns (does not throw) if env vars missing so build never breaks.
- src/i18n/index.ts: default export i18next instance; locales at src/i18n/locales/{es,en}.json. es is primary, en fallback. Keys already defined for the WHOLE app: app, banner, raffle, public(.legend), search, counters(sold/paid/raised/projected), reserve(+validation), whatsapp.messageTemplate (placeholders {{number}}{{name}}{{phone}}), admin(loginButton='Iniciar sesion con Google', accessDenied, signOut, table.*, filters.*, perSellerTotal, markPaid, release, csvExport), status.*, winner.*, footer.*. FEAT-003 should reuse these keys; add new keys to BOTH locale files.

TAILWIND: darkMode:'class', brand=amber scale (DEFAULT #F59E0B, 600 #D97706), fontFamily.sans=[Inter, system-ui, sans-serif]. Inter imported via Google Fonts @import in src/index.css.

STUB: src/App.tsx is a minimal i18n-wired placeholder (renders app.title); FEAT-003 replaces it with the real public/admin routes. src/main.tsx already wraps App in React.StrictMode + BrowserRouter and imports './index.css' and './i18n'.

GIT: initialized here on the default branch 'master' with an initial local commit (feat: scaffold... FEAT-001); NOT pushed, no remote. DEV-branch rename + the Spanish release commit are FEAT-003's responsibility.

NOTE: pnpm reported 'Ignored build scripts: esbuild' (normal pnpm security default); build works fine without approving it.
